text: Singha is the flagship beer of Boon Rawd Brewery, founded 1933 and privately owned and family-controlled ever since - no Thai state shareholding.
short: Singha is the flagship beer of Boon Rawd Brewery, founded 1933 and privately owned and family-controlled ever since - no Thai state shareholding.

source.quote: For over 80 years, the privately owned company has become a renowned beer and beverage producer, managed by 3rd and 4th generations of the descendants of the founder
